SELECT count(*) FROM location_type_supported_activities WHERE location_type_id = 'INVENTORY_SHORTFALL_LOCATION' AND supported_activities_string = 'INVENTORY_SHORTFALL';

changeSet.author: druchniewicz
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO location (id, version, name, location_number, location_type_id, parent_location_id, active, sort_order, date_created, last_updated) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), 0, CONCAT('SHORTFALL-', COALESCE(f.location_number, f.id)), CONCAT('SHORTFALL-', COALESCE(f.location_number, f.id)), 'INVENTORY_SHORTFALL_LOCATION', f.id, 1, 9999, '2026-08-12 12:00:00', '2026-08-12 12:00:00' FROM location f JOIN location_type lt ON f.location_type_id = lt.id WHERE lt.location_type_code = 'DEPOT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM location c WHERE c.parent_location_id = f.id AND c.location_type_id = 'INVENTORY_SHORTFALL_LOCATION');
